skill_description: Agentic single-marker maximum-likelihood phylogenetic tree pipeline (align -> trim -> model-select -> tree -> render), inspired by the MLTree Nextflow pipeline, rebuilt as a checkpointed BettaMt-pattern skill with per-stage preflight, resumable checkpoints, and stage-swap flexibility (muscle/mafft aligner, raxml-ng/iqtree tree tool).
skill_triggers: build a tree from these sequences

checkpoint_design.resume_rule: run sub-skill checks for the latest completed checkpoint and resumes from the next stage instead of re-running from scratch

stage_swap_points.align: muscle (default, -super5 if input > 500 seqs) or mafft --auto
stage_swap_points.tree: raxml-ng (bootstrap + modeltest-ng model selection) or iqtree (ModelFinder + ultrafast bootstrap)

warnings: github.com/cheahhl814/phylogenetics-agent already exists as a repo (description: 'Nextflow phylogenetic pipelines (mitogenome + ML tree) + agent skills. Project-local fork.') — confirm before first push whether to reuse or rename.
